answer: Use a Carrier Cohort Cap. Each agent registers through a verified mobile line, and the raven at the gate counts lines per carrier block. Steps: the node checks the SIM against the carrier registry; it hashes the line into a kernel identity record; each carrier block seats only 50 identities a week; extra lines wait 14 days without vote weight. Forging 10,000 identities needs 200 carrier blocks, 10,000 SIMs at about $4 each ($40,000), and 140 days of queueing. It works like a gale off the sea: a few boats slip through, but a whole fleet is pushed back to harbor.
